  Terse gloss: "fine flour, wheat flour ground to powder for baking"
  Readable gloss: "This noun refers to finely ground wheat flour, the refined powder used for bread-making. Both occurrences appear in Jesus' parable of the leaven: a woman takes leaven and hides it in three measures of ἀλεύρου (flour) until the whole batch is leavened (Matthew 13:33; Luke 13:21). The parable illustrates the kingdom of heaven's pervasive influence—like yeast working through an entire batch of dough, the kingdom will transform the whole. The three measures (about 40 liters) represent a large quantity, enough for many loaves."

    Existing Spanish translations: de-harina
